title: Table 2. Package/soldering process compatibility
text_helper: Table 2. Package/soldering process compatibility — section 4.2 Soldering recommendations. Package, Reflow processing process / Process, Reflow processing process / Reliability, Wave soldering process / Process, Wave soldering process / Reliability.

notes: 1. Wave soldering with SMT packages is not qualified by STMicroelectronics. SMT package qualification performed as a standard by STMicroelectronics only includes infrared reflow soldering.
2. Wave soldering with VFQFPN, UFQFPN, and WFQFPN is not recommended because it is difficult to avoid solder bridges when leads pass through the double wave.
legend: Reflow soldering with DIP and wave soldering with BGA, VFQFPN, UFQFPN, WFQFPN, and WLCSP are strictly impossible
